body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request successfully restructures the documentation for the ObjectStack Protocol as an independent protocol website with proper Fumadocs organization. The changes separate internal planning documents from public protocol documentation and establish seven clear root-level navigation categories.

**Changes:**
- Moved internal planning documents (DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md, PRIORITIES.md, PLANNING_INDEX.md, QUICK_START_IMPLEMENTATION.md, SUMMARY.md) to `/internal/planning/` directory
- Consolidated all technical documentation into `/content/docs/` with proper Fumadocs structure
- Established 7 root navigation categories: Quick Start, Tutorials, Guides, Concepts, Specifications, Standards, and References
- Added proper frontmatter (title, description) to all MDX files for better SEO and navigation
- Created hierarchical organization with architecture under specifications and migration under guides
- Updated cross-references in root-level files (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md, .github/prompts/README.md)
- Removed incorrect nested `"root": true` flags from References sub-directories
- Added complete Chinese (meta.cn.json) support for all root categories

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 49 out of 55 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| internal/planning/*.md | New planning documents moved from root directory with comprehensive roadmap, priorities, and implementation guides |
| internal/README.md | New index documenting the internal directory structure for contributors |
| internal/OLD_DOCS_README.md | Archive of previous docs/ directory README for historical reference |
| content/docs/standards/*.mdx | Added frontmatter to standards documentation files |
| content/docs/standards/meta.json | New root category configuration for Standards |
| content/docs/specifications/architecture/*.mdx | Added frontmatter and created architecture index under specifications |
| content/docs/guides/migration/*.mdx | Added frontmatter and created migration guides index under guides |
| content/docs/guides/advanced/**/*.mdx | Added frontmatter to advanced guides (AI integration, security, performance) |
| content/docs/*/meta.json | Updated root flags and page lists for proper navigation hierarchy |
| content/docs/*/meta.cn.json | Added/updated Chinese translations for all root categories |
| README.md | Updated all documentation links to reflect new structure |
| CONTRIBUTING.md | Updated planning document links to internal/planning/ |
| ARCHITECTURE.md | Updated roadmap links to internal/planning/ |
| RELEASE_NOTES.md | Updated roadmap link (incomplete - missing QUICK_START_IMPLEMENTATION.md update) |
| .github/prompts/README.md | Updated planning document links to internal/planning/ |
| content/docs/quick-start/*.mdx | Updated migration guide links to new location |
</details>
